g.title: All requested decisions are durably committed before saved is reported; readers receive a coherent state and the agent does not infer workflow approval from publication.
The result is unchanged with no duplicate entry or semantic increment.
The result retains a fitting storage receipt and exposes omitted detail without turning a successful publication into rejection.
The system returns conflict rather than duplicating entries or silently accepting stale decision basis.
The system reports busy or conflict and preserves the coherent winning work.
The system exposes recovery-required instead of saved or a usable mixed state; explicit recovery is a separate request.
